svg.title: mastyf.ai
svg.desc: Your model proposes. Mastyf decides. Tool calls from an agent reach Mastyf; safe ones are forwarded to files and GitHub, an rm -rf and a secret upload are stopped at the gate.
svg.text: Checks every tool call your AI agents make, before it runs.
Unsafe calls never reach your files, shell or network.
OPEN SOURCE · AGPL-3.0 · RUNS ON YOUR MACHINE
